question.text: In a private placement of InvIT units, what is the minimum and maximum number of investors allowed?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under InvIT Regulations, for private placement the number of investors shall not be less than 5 and not more than 1,000 investors. The Trap: 20 is the minimum unit holder requirement for IPO-listed InvITs, and 200 is the comparable REIT unit holder count -- these should not be confused with the private placement range. Note: Keep the private-placement bounds (5 to 1,000) separate from the public-offer minimum unit-holder thresholds for InvITs and REITs.
